thread:
amber_sales: FYI client Slate is ready to POC but wants to run a customer-tuned variant (slate-13b-custom) with 4-bit quant + KV cache and function-calling. They also require Private VPC + customer KMS. Any red flags? cc @mira_se

mira_se: Is the variant LoRA or full checkpoint? also what seq lengths are expected?

amber_sales: Partner says full checkpoint, seq commonly 3-4k for RAG prompts. No LoRA.

mira_se: 3-4k means KV paging potential. need tokenizer files and any special function-call tokens. can runtime run a quick probe?

dan_eng_runtime: I can. main worries: 4-bit kernel path and function-call token framing. I'll spin a smoke job and report back.

lee_security: On security: we can do Private with customer KMS, but we need their security questionnaire and region requirements. please confirm NDA signed.

olivia_pricing: For a 2-week Dedicated pilot (1 GPU-equivalent) we typically quote ~$7k provisional, plus burst capacity fees. final price depends on throughput and any extra eng work for custom kernels.

dan_eng_runtime: smoke results: quant kernels load, but KV paging raises p99 ~2x when seq >2048. found a special token <CALL_START> in their vocab; function-call outputs misaligned until we remap. need partner confirm tokenizer and agree on remap table.

mira_se: If they accept temporary latency increase for POC, we can proceed. if they insist on EU-hosted POC, check capacity. amber_sales: ask Slate for tokenizer.zip + 5 sample prompts and expected outputs; we'll run fp32 vs 4bit diffs.

amber_sales: Will request those and the security questionnaire now. I'll also share provisional pricing and note potential eng billable work for kernel support.

lee_security: I'll start mapping their questionnaire to our control matrix once received.

amber_sales: Thanks all — following up with Slate and will update thread when files arrive.
